verdict.rationale: Google Workspace's Context-Aware Access lets admins build per-app access policies from user identity, location, device security status and IP address. That covers the network, device and location signals and per-app targeting. Community reports confirm it is used in practice, but note that device verification depends on Chrome and Endpoint Verification, and that it is hard to tell which policy denied access. Missing for 10: any evidence of risk-signal-driven conditions, explicit per-group policy assignment for Context-Aware Access, and full device-signal support outside Chrome.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access decisions weigh context — network, device, location, and risk signals drive conditional policies per app and group

citations.quote: you can create granular access control security policies for apps based on attributes, such as user identity, location, device security status, and IP address
